title: debregeasia longifolia
intro: Debregeasia longifolia, commonly known as Nepali vine or Debregeasia, is a type of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Debregeasia longifolia include wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity against various pathogens. The bioactive constituents of this plant are mainly flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
